m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I parked her right here. Grrr...
...AKBARI! The ignoble traitor absconded with my Skyship! The fool! The Chimera will never fly true by his graceless hands.
Come now, we must sprint back to the Thieves Den. I'll hand the Dune Star to Ali Baboon personally, you muster the crew. To the Thieves Den!
We are humble Sky Pirates, held here by Ali Baboon until our Captain and First Mate, Akbari, bring the Dune Star as our ransom.
You are an adventurer, no? Could you the brave the Scaled Demons' Nest and secure the Dune Star to pay our ransom? Yes? Thank you!
Wizard, you return, but I do not see the Dune Star...
Compose yourself, Anwar! The Wizard has more to say...
Mighty Wizard! Please stay and hear our tale of woe. The fate of an entire crew hangs in the balance!
Do what our brave Captain and First Mate could not - secure the Dune Star from the Scaled Demon's Den to pay our ransom to Ali Baboon.
